ledger/P1.note: Reordered transfer checks only swap which listed exception is raised when several L3 conditions hold at once; permitted by L3.

ledger/P2.note: Merged loops debit earlier payers before a later payer fails: a loses 1 cent, house gains 1, on a raising call.

ledger/P3.note: fee*(i+1)//n - fee*i//n gives the remainder to the LAST names, spec gives it to the first r sorted names: {a:2,b:2,c:3} vs {a:3,b:2,c:2}.

ledger/P4.note: divmod rewrite is arithmetically identical; q + bool is an int.

ratelimit/P1.note: bisect_left keeps requests with s == t - window, which R3 says are not live: remaining 0 instead of 1, keys ['k'] instead of [], allow False instead of True.

ratelimit/P2.note: keys() order is unspecified (R7); sorting is allowed.

ratelimit/P3.note: Comprehension prunes the same prefix since the event list is always sorted (clock rule).

ratelimit/P4.note: remaining() ticks and prunes exactly as allow() did; <= 0 test equals len(q) >= capacity.

intervals/P1.note: bisect_right on [x, inf] finds the last interval with start <= x; equivalent to the linear scan.

intervals/P2.note: not s > end / max() is the same merge condition and update.

intervals/P3.note: left/mid/right partition merges overlapping and touching intervals; result stays canonical. No diff in 9000 fuzz runs.

intervals/P4.note: lo <= hi keeps empty pieces: remove(0,5) from [0,10) leaves [(0,0),(5,10)]; intervals() must have start < end.

pricing/P1.note: gross*90//100 != gross - gross*10//100 when gross % 10 != 0: line_total(1,11) is 9 instead of 10; checkout discount 2 instead of 1.

pricing/P2.note: UnknownCoupon subclasses PricingError (allowed); the dropped clamp never fired since each coupon minimum exceeds its amount and net >= 0.

pricing/P3.note: Incremental floor split yields the same non-increasing list summing to total, values differing by at most 1.

pricing/P4.note: divmod form equals floor((a*825+5000)/10000) for every int.

depgraph/P1.note: D1 names GraphError for a self-dependency; raising GraphError instead of its subclass CycleError satisfies it.

depgraph/P2.note: FIFO queue lists c before a although a becomes ready after b and a < c; D5 requires the smallest ready node each step: expected [b,a,c], got [b,c,a].

depgraph/P3.note: Depths are contiguous from 0, so grouping by depth reproduces the same non-empty layers.

depgraph/P4.note: min() over a ready set is the same greedy choice as the heap.
